rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the top of a person’s head.

example.english: The crown of my head is really itchy.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tau4 deng2 hou2 han4

rows.note: Use this for a royal, imperial, or princely headdress.

example.english: The crown in the museum is beautiful.
example.traditional: 博物館入面嗰頂王冠好靚。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 min6 go2 deng2 wong4 gun1 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this technical dental term for a prosthetic cap fitted over a tooth.

example.english: The dentist said I need to have a crown replaced.
example.traditional: 牙醫話要幫我換個牙冠。
example.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 jiu3 bong1 ngo5 wun6 go3 ngaa4 gun1

rows.note: Use this for the highest part of a hill or mountain.

example.english: We hiked for two hours before reaching the crown of the mountain.
example.traditional: 我哋行咗兩個鐘先到山頂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 sin1 dou3 saan1 deng2
